reason: DISPROVEN as a data artifact -- the L1 FAIL is a genuine PROCEDURE-DEFECT (SC-3384 currency-blind native ABA decision-table lookup + downstream Currency Conversion step). All three mandate conditions are affirmatively met on the live current active V21 by my own fresh re-measurement: (1) inputs valid and match test_setup -- EUR quote, AAMP, EUR PBE active+non-zero 2943.99, the three required attributes present and price-impacting, Direct/New/Fortra Originated/GSW=false, CompletedWithPricing; (2) the intended ABA-Override branch fired on those valid inputs -- Source_List_Price__c/Base_Price__c/Pre_Partner_Price__c all stamped 1575 (the only-active USD override), and the USD control of the IDENTICAL combo (0QLWC000003l1tO4AQ) nets 1575, proving the branch applies the override correctly and is NOT a dead line; (3) my own Force-reprice (14:19:42Z, isSuccess:true) reproduced L1=1471.995 EUR vs expected EUR list 2943.99. The headless-$0 trap does NOT apply to L1: L1 is not $0, it carries a real sourced value that was FX-converted; the only legitimate source of 1575 in the org is the USD ABA override (0 non-USD ABA rows, no EUR override exists). Not EXPECTATION-ERROR: design intent (Confluence 'Currency Conversion for Pricebooks', Marc-confirmed) is per-currency STATIC values with NO quote-time conversion, so a USD override FX'd into an EUR line is the documented bug, not expected. A real UI rep building an EUR AAMP config with these attributes would hit the same currency-blind leak (uiUserWouldHit=yes). The executor's corrected narrative is right: L2's $0 is a separate currency-AGNOSTIC anomaly (USD control also $0), not the currency defect -- the verdict rests on L1. Verdict FAIL / PROCEDURE-DEFECT retained; agreesWithExecutor=true.
